title: A bad deploy rolls itself back
summary: Merge a change with a hidden bug while users are on the site, and watch AWS undo it.

steps.title: Put normal traffic on production
steps.narration: A load generator in AWS plays the part of customers browsing and ordering, so there is real traffic when the bad version arrives.

steps.title: Open a change with a hidden bug
steps.narration: This pull request looks fine and CI passes. The bug only shows up under real traffic.

args.head: demo/canned-bug
args.title: perf: cache product prices
args.body: Demo scenario `bad-deploy`: this change passes CI but fails under load. Opened by the demo console.

steps.title: The AI reviewer reads it
steps.narration: Every PR gets an AI code review that blocks real bugs. This one is subtle, a database connection that is never returned, and the reviewer usually catches it.

steps.title: A person overrides the review
steps.narration: To show what happens when a bug gets past every check, an admin overrides the AI review on purpose. Only admins can, and the override is on the PR for everyone to see.

args.body: /override-ai-review Demo: letting the canned bug through on purpose to show the automatic rollback.

steps.title: Checks pass and the queue merges it
steps.narration: Tests cannot catch everything. Every check is green, so the merge queue merges it like any other change.

wait.subject: pr#{pr}
wait.description: The merge queue merges the PR

steps.title: The deploy starts
steps.narration: Merging is deploying. The new image goes to staging, then production.

steps.title: An alarm fires
steps.narration: The new version reaches production after staging. Under real traffic it starts failing requests, and CloudWatch notices within a minute.

wait.description: A production alarm goes into ALARM

steps.title: AWS rolls it back
steps.narration: The deployment is unhealthy, so ECS puts the previous version back on its own. Nobody was paged to do it.

wait.subject: prod
wait.description: Production rolls back to the previous version

steps.title: Production is healthy again
steps.narration: The alarm clears once the old version is serving every request.
